subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Repulse
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Repulse"** means to drive back or repel, often used in the context of repelling an attack or an unwanted advance. (अस्वीकृति करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The army was able to repulse the enemy forces after a long battle.
 
 
 
• **"Repel"** refers to driving or forcing back, or to be distasteful or disagreeable to. (वापस धकेलना)
 
 
• **Example:** The new policy is likely to repel many potential investors.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Repulse'** is **'Repel'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Substitute** (प्रतिस्थापन): A person or thing acting or serving in place of another.

 
 
• **Example:** The coach used a substitute for the injured player.
 
 
 
• **Recover** (स्वस्थ होना): To return to a normal state of health, mind, or strength.
 
 
• **Example:** It took her months to recover from the surgery.
 
 
 
• **Reprove** (डाँटना): To reprimand or censure someone.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher reproved the student for being late.
